IBEW.text:
**Trampin the IBEW Indoor Locals — Tuesday, October 6, 2026**

**LU-613 Atlanta, GA** is the data center play right now. Sixty calls deep with Miller, Inglett & Stubbs, and Whitehead all running QTS Fayetteville hard—**$42/hr** on 4-10s and 1-8s, Monday through Friday. Miller's got 77 hands on the main call alone; this board's moving fast. Shop work in Hampton through Miller too if you want shorter days. Book 1 looks clear.

**LU-26 Washington, DC** is packed tight: 65 calls, nearly 600 hands waiting. JE Richards is double-posting 112 hands each at the Fredericksburg data center—possible 58-hour weeks, background check required. Dynalectric's 19-hand call at Aldie runs 4-12s Monday through Thursday plus Friday 8s. If you're comfortable with infrastructure and testing, Electrical Test Tech is hanging 18 hands doing NETA maintenance across DC, MD, and Virginia. Rates aren't published here, but the volume's real.

**LU-474 Memphis, TN** is the cash lane. Cache Valley Electric's posting 100 hands at **$53.25/hr** day shift—5-10s and 2-8s, the best rate on this board. Copperhead's night shift at **$38.25/hr** runs rolling 4-on/1-off with **$10 over scale** kicker. ArchKey Sachs is in West Memphis hitting Google at **$38.25/hr** with **$125/day per diem** incentive, 6 a.m. start, 4-10s and 2-8s. Three solid contractors, three different angles—pick your poison on hours and daylight.

**LU-575 Portsmouth, OH** is thin but hot: three calls, 179 hands sitting. TSC's Amazon North Campus in Jeffersonville starts Monday, October 12, 4-10s, two separate 89-hand posts. Tight board, fast rotation.

**LU-481 Indianapolis, IN** has Lilly work anchoring it. Ermco's 10-hand call at Lilly LP1 in Lebanon runs 5-10s Monday through Friday, 6 a.m. to 4:30 p.m., temperature control experience preferred. Industrial Electric's pulling 6-10s Monday through Saturday on K153 new construction south side. Pay data's buried, but the Lilly footprint here is sticky work.

Data centers continue to vacuum hands across the board—Wisconsin, Michigan, Ohio, and the South are the pipeline right now.

LINEMAN.text:
**Trampin the IBEW Lineman Locals — Tuesday, October 6, 2026**

**LU-1547 Anchorage, AK** is running hot with 41 calls chasing just 52 hands—that's a 0.78 ratio, the tightest board in today's snapshot. Northern Powerline Constructors has work at JBER on airfield lighting and underground feeder rebuilds, with one Journeyman Lineman call hitting **$76.90/hr**. Inside wireman positions run **$57.44/hr** on the same job. Carlos Tree Service and New Horizons Telecom round out the slate. Remote Alaska work always means commitment, but the math here screams opportunity.

**LU-1426 Grand Forks, ND** shows 20 calls, 51 hands—another tight market. Parsons Electric's 18-hand Polaris Forge Data Center play in Harwood runs 6-10's with **$100/day non-taxed** incentive Mon-Fri and **$150 Sat/Sun**. That's inside wireman work at **$44.80/hr** base with real teeth in the per diem. Northern Valley Electrical at Grand Forks Air Base adds **$75/day incentive** on 4-10's. GPS radius is 100+ miles; this is travel work with legs.

**LU-84 Newnan, GA** carries 29 calls into 122 hands—a more forgiving board but solid work. HEART UTILITIES' 35-hand Savannah lineman call at **$46.80/hr** with **$150 per diem** on 5-10's is the anchor. SERVICE ELECTRIC's Nashville SPP work (8 JLs, **$46.80/hr**, **$125/day**) is moving to Bainbridge. Substation tech calls run **$44.46/hr**.

**LU-474 Memphis, TN** has 7 calls chasing roughly 143 hands—a loaded book. All seven calls hit **$38.25/hr** on data center inside wireman jobs: Cache Valley Electric, ArchKey Sachs (Google West Memphis), and Copperhead (day and night shifts). ArchKey sweetens it with **$125/day incentive** for full shift attendance. Copperhead offers **$10/hr over scale** per diem and rotating 4-on/1-off schedules.

**LU-602 Amarillo, TX** runs 6 calls, 74 hands. Both Cache Valley and Rosendin are hammering the Llano data center project (20 Inside JW slots each at **$52.30/hr**), plus Rosendin's Claude build with **60/60/50 per diem**, **OT=DT**. This is concentrated, high-wage inside work.

Data centers and transmission rebuilds are pulling bodies hard—the board depth is disappearing fast in markets with specialized infrastructure projects.

UA.text:
**Trampin the UA Locals — Tuesday, October 6, 2026**

**LU-776 Lima, OH** is running the widest board right now — 6 calls, ~41 hands needed. Gem's got two separate calls: one for combo welders (testing required, no benefit pyramiding) at the Fab Shop, and another pipefitter gig on 7-10s at BDO Fab Shop where you'll need to cert current. Graham's Cenovus Maintenance call is dangling **$5/hr PD pyramiding incentive** for pipefitters at height — must carry current DISA. Nooter's also on Cenovus with **$125/day incentive pay** for pipefitters needing DISA current. Book depth is real here; this is where the volume is.

**LU-213 St John, NB** sits tight with 5 calls against ~5 hands — nearly Book 1 territory. Lake Utopia Paper in Lorneville has a welder slot (F3/F4, carbon stick and tig test) and a journeyman pipefitter spot on 4x10s. Irving Oil Refinery is moving shutdown work: CAM's running F3/F4 welders with shutdown incentives and F6/F5 testing, while Stuart Olson's got another Irving Oil welder call on 6x10s. All industrial agreement rates; this is old-school refinery work if you hold the certifications.

**LU-192 Cheyenne, WY** is thin — 1 call, ~2 hands — but PMI's posting a plumber slot at Fort Meade VA Hospital in Sturgis with **$100/day PD**. Med gas ticket and OSHA10 required, background must pass. Not enough volume to chase solo.

The money's staying in the fab shops and refineries; shutdown season is pulling certified welders east into the Maritimes while maintenance work keeps Lima's pipefitter books turning.
